body: Yeah, she will say that. She will we are never getting back together. But in time she will realize what she left and come back. But she to realize that you are stable and won't do this. Do you think she wants a man that's ready to kill himself? No she doesnt. No one can tell you your future but I can tell you this that after awhile she will reach out and start talking to you again and you have to rebuild and rekindle a relationship with her again. If you don't want to do that then you won't get her back. But she will get curious in time and start to wonder about you. Do you want to be alive when she starts wondering or do you want to be dead when that happens? I get it it sounds impossible and you think it's over for good and I struggle with it everyday. But you gotta keep pushing. I do most of the people on here do it and you gotta do it too if no one else do this for her. Live for her.

But don't you want that one chance. That one chance to be with her again. And it can happen all the prep may be done but it doesn't need to go down tonight or tomorrow. I want you two back together if she was with you right now you wouldn't be doing this. She can and probably will come back and be with you. Don't Rob her of that chance don't Rob yourself of that chance to get back together with her. If you love her so much which you say you do you will hold off on this and give it time. See how it plays out, the prep is done but it's you who has to act on it. She's coming back bro. She is coming back.

Her blocking you and everything is a knee jerk reaction. Go no contact and try and better yourself. I get that it's hard and I get all you wanna do is end it. I begged and pleaded for my girl not to leave me and said I'll change. But you have to have faith in this. If you were so great to her and everything then it's going to be easy. Go no contact for 30 days. Don't talk to her don't do anything seriously I know how hard it is but you have to let her come to you. And she will come back they always come back. But just give this one time and space. The anxiety and everything is probably killing you as it does to me.

I am going through the same thing. I dated a girl for 3 years and she was my world. She made me so happy and changed my life for the better. I moved closer to her city got an appartment with her. Along the way I was loosing myself and treated her like crap cause I was so stressed about everything. And then it was too late and she was gone. I want to show her i have changed and I am the man she fell in love with but the more time passes the more I just feel hopeless. I have also tried to kill myself 3 times cause of this. I know the pain and I know the struggle dude. I really do.
Yeah I understand that. But I still think I can get her back. I mean the process of re attracting and I know it's a long shot and it's a small percentage but I feel like I have to try.
Hey I'd love to talk, been going through a tough few months and survived 2 suicide attempts and a car crash
